title: Outcome
description: schemaVersion 2.0.0. Server-computed attempt outcome, populated exclusively when learning_attempt.completion_status = CONSOLIDATED (07_15_01 v1.1 §11-bis.5). New in WEB-M2 — neither 07_08 nor 07_09 define this shape (07_08 §8 explicitly states the runtime does not return outcome directly); designed for this implementation, informed by 07_15_01 §9/§11 and the WEB-M2 planning rounds.
